gloss: to stock; to have a full selection; to get everything together

definitions.gloss: to stock (a range of items); to have a full selection available
definitions.explanation: To carry or maintain a comprehensive variety of products or goods for sale. Commonly used in retail and commercial contexts to describe a shop's inventory.

definitions.gloss: to gather and prepare (documents, items needed)
definitions.explanation: To collect and assemble all the necessary items or documents so that everything required is ready and complete.

notes:
A compound verb formed from ⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧ (to take) and ⟦{揃|そろ}える→揃える：01952_soroeru⟧ (to arrange, to make uniform). Sense 1 is commonly used in retail and commercial contexts to describe having a variety of products available. Sense 2 means to collect and prepare everything that is needed.

USAGE:
Sense 1 is very common in polite commercial speech, often in the て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧/て⟦おります→おる：01324_oru⟧ form to describe what a shop carries. Sense 2 is used more generally when preparing or assembling items.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{商品|しょうひん}→商品：01436_shouhin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{取|と}り{揃|そろ}える: to stock products
- ⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{取|と}り{揃|そろ}える: to gather documents
- ⟦{豊富|ほうふ}→豊富：03620_houfu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{取|と}り{揃|そろ}える: to have a rich selection
- ⟦{幅広|はばひろ}く→幅広い：11326_habahiroi⟧{取|と}り{揃|そろ}える: to stock a wide range

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{揃|そろ}える→揃える：01952_soroeru⟧: to arrange, to put in order — more general, without the nuance of gathering from various sources
- ⟦{品揃|しなぞろ}え→品揃え：11844_shinazoroe⟧: product lineup — noun form describing the range of goods available
- ⟦{用意|ようい}する→用意する：22428_youisuru⟧: to prepare — more general preparation, not specifically gathering a variety
